text_block_list.text:
The days leading up to the exhibition match
passed by in a whirlwind.
choice_data_list: How does this training form look?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: My body hasn't gotten fully used to it yet—but I can feel my muscles being trained efficiently.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for running alongside me today!
I look forward to working with you again!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
She possessed an incredible late-race kick.
That's why there was so much to learn from it.
—Please, let us exchange notes right now.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Taaaaaaaahhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Phew... haah—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...It's strange. My body feels so light,
like I could run forever.

I did everything I had to do so that
her brilliance would receive the true recognition it deserves.
She gave it her all in response, and that was reflected in her growth metrics. I had complete confidence that she would deliver results.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Yes. And next time—I shall add
the most beautiful blossom of all to my bouquet.
—And then.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: An exhibition match bringing together all the Tiara Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Analysis
text_block_list.text:
Race 1 is the 2000m Turf Inner Track—
Featuring an Umamusume making a stellar comeback, this star-studded lineup is worthy of a GⅠ race!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: —Yes!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
It's truly a dream match!
I wonder who's gonna win—gotta be Chrono or Bouquet, right?!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
It'd be so hype if either of the returning two won!
I really want Gran or Loves to win!

A swirl of anticipation and excitement fills the stands.
Before long—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
All runners are in the gate.
—And they're off!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
A clean, even start for everyone.
Chrono Genesis positions near the front of the mid-pack—

Gran Alegria, Curren Bouquetd'or,
and Loves Only You follow behind—

"Chronooo! You can win this, hang in there!"
"Gran-chan, we're cheering for you!"
"Do your best, Loves!" "Go get 'em, Bouquet!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Rounding the 4th corner, into the final stretch—!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: From heeeere on ooouuuuut...!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Chrono Genesis bursts through from the inner rail!
Gran Alegria follows close behind—and then!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Loves Only You from the outside,
Loves Only You on the outside!
What incredible explosive speed—!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...I... too...
—Kgh! Yaaahhh!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
100 meters left, Curren Bouquetd'or closes in!
Chrono Genesis, Gran Alegria, and Loves Only You
are locked in a fierce battle—!

text_block_list.name: Chrono & Gran & Loves
text_block_list.text:
Yaaaaaaaaahhhhh!!
Haaaaaaaaahhhhh!!
Taaaaaaaaahhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
All three cross the line locked together—
First place goes to Chrono Genesis—!!
(UOOOOOOOOOH!!)

Rousing cheers and thunderous applause.
Those joyous voices swirling over the turf—
Somewhere—
In the distance, I heard it.

text_block_list.name: Analysis
text_block_list.text:
Man, Chrono Genesis,
Loves Only You, Gran Alegria!
All three of them had terrifying turn of foot!

text_block_list.name: Analysis
text_block_list.text:
I could really feel the pride of rivals who pushed each other to the limit,
it warmed my heart!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Ah... Trainer-san...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"I just barely made the board...
I'm so sorry, Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
After you gave me so, so much—
support, too...
choice_data_list: ...No, I should be the one apologizing.

text_block_list.text:
"I thought I had done everything I was supposed to.
And she responded with everything she had.
I was confident—or at least, I was supposed to be."

Even so, however,
she was unable to claim victory.

Far from it—I couldn't even manage
to include her among the top three—

—The next day. A sports newspaper arrived,
featuring coverage of the exhibition match.

"The Big Three Tiara Umamusume Showdown"
"A fierce clash: Chrono, Loves, and Gran"
"A battle between the representatives of their generation"—
Titles like that are lined up in red text with yellow outlines.

There's no time to look down.
I need to come up with a strategy and prepare for the Senior Class.
Yet even as I think that—

"If only Curren Bouquetd'or's Trainer
hadn't been someone like me... she could have..."

A single possibility that suddenly surfaced that day
refused to leave my mind, no matter what.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: (Once again—my name is nowhere to be found.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(If only I had won――maybe this time,
I could have shone a light on him.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(If only I had won――maybe this time,
I could have shone a light on her.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(...Ngh, but still—
I mustn't give up.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: (Even a withered seedling, if treated properly, will sprout lush green leaves and blossom once more.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(――I have to switch gears.
If I want to gather this bouquet, I need to stay strong――)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: (Because I have to become strong.)

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text: I couldn't make them shine, huh—

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text: I was wondering why you looked unusually gloomy lately, but now I get it.
choice_data_list: I want to do something about it.
I want to do something about it.

text_block_list.text:
We're not utilizing Curren Bouquetd'or's talent to the fullest.
Her running, her presence—she should be shining so much brighter.

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Hmm.
Well, I can understand where you're coming from.

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text: ...This is just one suggestion, but...

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text: There's a proverb somewhere that says two heads are better than one, right? In other words—

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text: How about asking the chief trainer who used to look after you to come watch your training?
